# cpanel_ssh_public_key (Data Source)

Looks up one public OpenSSH key stored by cPanel. The provider always selects cPanel's public-key mode and never reads private key material.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_ssh_public_key" "deploy" {
  name = "deploy"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The cPanel SSH public-key base filename without `.pub`.

### Read-Only

- `authorized` (Boolean) Whether cPanel reports the public key as authorized.
- `created_at` (Number) The public-key creation time reported by cPanel as a Unix timestamp.
- `fingerprint_sha256` (String) The OpenSSH SHA-256 public-key fingerprint.
- `key_type` (String) The canonical OpenSSH public-key type.
- `modified_at` (Number) The public-key modification time reported by cPanel as a Unix timestamp.
- `public_key` (String) The canonical OpenSSH public key without its comment.
